test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

‘M & N’ means ‘M is the wife of N’,

‘M @ N’ means ‘M is the brother of N’,

‘M $ N’ means ‘M is the father of N’,

‘M # N’ means ‘M is the son of N’.

Based on the above, how is T related to G if ‘T @ S # M & N $ G’?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] Decoding the Symbols: M is Symbol & @
